title: Each language at a domain of its own
lead: example.com serves English and German, example.cz Czech — from one app and one route tree. The host and the pathname give the locale, so a link to the other domain is all a language switch takes.

domains.title: localeDomains
domains.text: A host the map lists renders its own locales alone, whatever the visitor's header asks for.

links.title: localizeHref
links.text: A link names the other domain only where it leaves this one, so a link on the same host stays a client navigation.

redirect.title: One host per page
redirect.text: A pathname of another host's locale is sent there with a 308: example.com/o-nas lands on example.cz/o-nas.
